question: At present, Ritika’s age is 3 times the age of Vipul. After 7 years, Ritika will be 2 times as old as Vipul. What is the present age of Ritika (in years)?
solution:
**Given:**

Ritika’s age is 3 times the age of Vipul

After 7 years, Ritika will be 2 times as old as Vipul

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of Vipul is X

The present age of Ritika's = 3X

After 7 years

The Ritika's age after 7 years = 2 × (X + 7)

⇒ 3X + 7 = 2X + 14

⇒ 3X - 2X = 14 - 7

⇒ X = 7

The present age of Ritika's = 7 × 3 = 21

**∴ The required result will be 21.**
